tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (343)༄༅/ /dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi zab chos lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi khrid yig ye shes 'od 'phro zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ // /
(343)༄༅/ /dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi zab chos lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi khrid yig ye shes 'od 'phro zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (343)༄༅// dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi zab chos lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi khrid yig ye shes 'od 'phro zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(344)༄༅// na mo gu ru tsa tu rde bā ya// mchog gi grub stsol dpal ldan bla ma dang*// phyi nang gegs sel yon tan bogs 'don pa// byin rlabs lha bzhi'i zhabs la phyag byas te// de yi khrid rim mdo tsam gsal bar bya// mkhas grub chen po khyung po rnal 'byor pa de nyid kyis ye shes ḍā ki rnam pa gnyis gtso bor gyur pa'i rgya gar mkhas grub brgya dang lnga bcu'i thugs bcud rdzogs par gsol bas shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa'i skyes chen rnams la mdo sngags kyi zab chos rgya mtsho tsam gyi gzhung dang gdams pa'i bka' yongs su rdzogs pa mnga' zhing mchog gi grub pa nyams 'og tu chud pa sha stag byon pa lags// deng sang rgyun bzhugs pa'i gtso bo gdams ngag gi skor bzhi'am lngar grags pa las/ 'dir rgya gar lho phyogs pa 'chi ba med pa'i rig 'dzin brnyes nas mchog gi go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa grub chen rā hu la gup+ta'i gdams pa dang gtso bor 'brel pa lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi khrid kyi rim pa 'chad pa la gnyis/ gang las byung ba brgyud pa'i lo rgyus mdor smos/ de las byung ba khrid rim (345)dngos rgyas par 'chad pa'o// dang po ni/ grub chen sha ba ri dbang phyug la lha bzhis zhal gzigs shing sgrub thabs gsungs/ de la mnga' bdag mai tri pas gsan te sgrub thabs bkod/ mkhas grub khyung pos 'di las kyang gsan par gsal te byin rlabs lha bzhi 'bral ba med ces 'byung bas mgon po'i gsan yul gtso bor yin pa'i phyir ro// 'on kyang gdams ngag 'di'i brgyud khungs gtso bo ni grub chen rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra ste/ de nyid rgya gar lho phyogs el bhi sha zhes pa rdo rje mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa gzhir rgyal rigs su sku 'khrungs ma thag nas lha bzhi zhal gzigs shing byin gyis brlabs/ gzhon nu'i skabs su sngon las kyi lhag ma bsnyun drag por smin pas thugs byung ste chos la zhugs shing mdo sngags thams cad la ches mkhas par sbyangs/

gu ṇa sā ga ra dang rat+na sā ga ra sogs kyi gdams ngag la brten te thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu grub/ mthar sku tsho'i rig 'dzin brnyes shing phyag rgya chen po'i mchog grub pa de nyid la grub pa'i (346)bla ma rnams kyi bkas bskul te mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor 'phan yul 'jog por chig rir mdzad pa'i skabs chos sgo skyel gyi tshul du rgya gar na nyi ma shar ba dang rdzu 'phrul gyis byon pas bod la nyi ma ma shar ba la pheb// ring zhig bzhugs te mgon po dkar mthing*/ rlung shing rta can la sogs pa'i gdams ngag zab mo du ma dang*// khyad par lha bzhi'i gdams skor cha lag dang bcas pa gnang ba khyung po nyid kyis thugs nyams su bzhes pas slob ma las dag pa rnams la lha bzhi'i skur dngos su snang ba sogs grub pa chen po nyams 'og tu chud/ de nyid kyis rmog lcogs pa sogs la gnang ba nas byin rlabs dang gdams pa'i bka' srol bar ma chad du byon te kho bos rdo rje theg pa'i gsang ba thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa mtha' dag gi gsang mdzod 'dzin pa la rdo rje 'chang chen po dang dbyer ma mchis pa/ 'phags pa'i sa chen po la bzhugs shing mi las 'das pa'i skyes chen 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la gsol ba btab ste dgyes bzhin bka' drin tu stsal ba yin// rmog lcogs pa rin chen brtson 'grus la lha bzhis sgrub thabs dngos su gsungs pa dang*/ brgyud pa kha cig la ḍā ki bde ba'i dngos grub mas gnang ba'ang bshad pa'i phyir nye brgyud khyad par ba de dag kyang 'dir 'dul/ 'di la'ang lha bzhi'i sgos sgrub dang dril sgrub gnyis su yod par bshad pa las skabs su bab pa'i 'chad bya ni lha bzhi'i dril sgrub nyid yin no// gnyis pa brgyud pa de ldan gyi gdams ngag dngos 'chad pa la'ang gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ thun gyi sngon 'gro ni/

mal bde bar 'dug /lus gnad spyi mthun bca'/ rlung ro bsal la dran pa mngon tu bzhag /khrid kyi sngon 'gro la'ang gnyis/ (347)skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'o// dang po ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la dkon mchog skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam par bzhugs pa la bdag gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig tu dril te/ deng nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba'i blo rtse gcig pas/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad skyabs kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi ba lags so// zhes grangs ci nus su brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can ji snyed pa de thams cad bdag gi pha ma drin can sha stags yin/ 'di rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor thar dus med par 'khyams pa snying re rje/ 'di rnams 'khor ba las bsgral ba'i slad du bdag gis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang dus myur ba nyid du thob nges pa zhig bya snyam pa smon pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ de 'thob par bya ba'i slad du rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim gyi zab gnad gcig tu bsdus pa'i nye lam grub thob 'ba' zhig pa'i snyan brgyud lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi rnal 'byor zab mo nyams su blangs pas/ bla ma lha bzhi'i go 'phang myur du 'grub pa dang*/ sems can thams cad de'i go 'phang la 'gong par bgyi'o snyam pa'i 'jug pa byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ ngag tu/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab lam lha bzhi dril sgrub nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan kha yar brjod/ skyabs yul mi dmigs par bzhag /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la'ang gnyis/ bskyed bzlas kyi rnal 'byor ngang*/ zab mo'i dbang len pa'o// dang po ni/

oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa (348)hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dra ba gur bla bre phyi rol du ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ pad nyi 'jigs dus kyi gdan la rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes 'od phung gi klong na bzhugs par gsal ba'i spyi bor chos 'byung dwangs gsal rnyogs med 'od kyi rang bzhin phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ rtsa ba phra ba rang gi tshangs bug tu zug cing kha gdengs g.yel ba/ bde bar 'char zhing bde ba rgyas pa'i dbus su rab tu rgyas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa/ de'i lte ba'i ze'u 'bru khru gang tsam mtho ba'i steng du nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la hūm̐ sngon po las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma/ rnam pa rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog bai ḍūr+ya'i mdangs can/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol thabs su 'dzin pas yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ yab yum gnyis ka rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan cing dar gyi na bzas klubs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung dang pad skyil can/ byin rlabs dang ye shes kyi rang 'od mtha' yas pa spro ba/ de'i mdun phyogs kyi pad 'dab la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tshogs bdag dkar po gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i gdan la hūm̐ nag po las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal bsgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dbu skra dmar ser me ltar du 'bar zhing gyen du brdzes pa/ dpral bar sin+dhu ra'i thig les byugs shing spyi bor mi bskyod pas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gnam lcags kyi gri gug

/bar pas thod (349)skam gyi phreng ba/ tha mas seng ldeng gi ḍā ma ru drag tu 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos thod pa dmar chen gyis bkang ba/ bar pas mdung rtse gsum pa/ tha mas rdo rje'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i dor shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan cha drug dang sbrul chun rigs lnga dang phyag zhabs rnams la dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ sbom thung lto ba 'phyang zhing yan lag rags pa/ glang chen ko rlon stod la g.yogs shing stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs la dar ljang gu'i ska rags bcings pa/ zhabs bzhengs stabs 'gro 'phro la 'chams pa lta bus ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ bla ma'i g.yas phyogs kyi pad 'dab la nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po las gri gug hrīḥs mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar la smug pa'i mdangs chags pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ zhal 'dzum zhing mche ba nas tsam 'bur ba/ spyan gsum g.yon phyogs su gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug thur du brkyang zhing*/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ mchan khung g.yon na rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas shing rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas 'jig byed g.yon bskums pas dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ ye shes kyi rang zer kun tu 'bar ba/ bla ma'i rgyab kyi pad 'dab la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po las pad+ma dkar po hrīḥs mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zla ba'i mdog can/ zhi zhing 'dzum la dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra dpung pa'i steng na nag sil le 'phyang zhing 'od dpag med kyi cod pan dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas bum pa bsnams (350)shing g.yon pa'i ma theb srin sbyar bas me tog pad+ma dkar po snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/

zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pa'i stabs kyis 'ja' zer kyi klong na bzhugs pa/ bla ma'i g.yon gyi pad 'dab la zla ba'i steng du tāṃ ljang gu las ut+pal ljang gu tāṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu/ lang tsho dar la bab cing lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin pus mo'i steng du brkyangs shing g.yon dkon mchog gsum mtshon pa'i phyag rgyas ut+pal ljang gu'i yu ba thugs kar bsnams pa'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad du kha bye ba/ don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan can/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pa'i stabs kyis rang 'od kyi dbus na bzhugs pa ste gtso 'khor lnga po snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa gsal bar bsgom/ de nas gtso 'khor lnga ka'i dpral par oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'chang dang lha bzhi'i rnam par spyan drangs te spyi bo'i lha so so la thim par mos la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ/ brjod cing spyi bo'i lha de rnams skyabs gnas ma lus pa 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos/ rang gi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis nyer spyod la sogs pa phyi/ bdud rtsi dang 'dod yon lnga pos nang*/ snyoms 'jug las skyes ba'i bde stong gis gsang ba'i mchod pa phul bar mos la/ de thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i spros bral gyi ting nge 'dzin la blo bzhag ste/ bla ma rin po che lha bzhi'i tshogs dang bcas pa la bdag gis phyi me tog bdug spos/ nang sha (351)lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba bde stong gi ye shes/ yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa la sogs pa mchod pa'i khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod cing mnyes par bgyi'o// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pa tsam gyi mthar gsol 'debs kyi bzlas pa la 'jug kyang chog la/

bla ma'i gsung rgyun tu 'dir mchod bstod bya bar gsungs pa ltar spro na mchod pa bshad ma thag pas 'thus/ bstod pa rgyas par ni/ gang gis= /srin po'i gzugs kyi= /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro= /skyon gyis ma gos= /lha dang lha min cod pan sogs sh+lo ka re res bstod/ bsdu na// byin rlabs ma lus 'byung ba'i sgo// dngos grub ma lus thob pa'i gnas// bar chad ma lus sel ba'i lha// bla ma lha bzhi'i tshogs la 'dud// ces bstod/ 'dir dam pa kha cig gis mchod bstod kyi tshab tu yan lag bdun pa dang maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar bzhed pas de ltar spro na de dag lhag por byas pa la 'gal ba med pas yan lag bdun pa gang yang rung ba'i tshigs bcad dang*/ maṇ+ḍal bka' rgya ma bcas mchod bstod kyi rjes su bya/ de nas so so'i sngags rnams yid gzhan tu ma yengs par mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs kyi tshul du bzla zhing bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong gi dmigs pa bsgom ste/ de'ang thog mar bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon dang bcas pa bkrus shing dag /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs gcig char du thob par mos la sngags/ na mo bud+dha ya/ na mo gu ru he/ badz+ra bī ra bī re ṇī/ shrī ḍā ka dā ki nī/ dzo ka dzo ki nī/ sarba bud+dha bo nghi sa twā ya shwa ra ṇaṃ gats+tsha mi kyai/ zhes bzla/ des 'gres te/ mgon po la mos (352)gus byas pas/ mgon po'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang*/ sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon thams cad dag /khyad par rang 'dra ba'i sku phra mo dpag tu med pa char phab pa ltar byon nas rang gi lus kyi nang gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dmar chems chem zhal du gsol/ mgon po'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par mos te/

oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bi gh+na bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzla/ yang rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang gnas nas bdud rtsi dmar po'i rgyun babs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang*/ sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon thams cad dag /rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rgyud la thob par mos la/ oṃ badz+ra na ra kraṃ kraṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzla/ yang spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba btab pas/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i sku dang phyag gi bum pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar nar gyis byung*/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang*/ sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon thams cad dag /spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rgyud la thob par mos te/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa na maḥs man+ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bzla/ yang rje btsun ma sgrol ma la mos gus byas pas/ sgrol ma'i zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang*/ sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon thams cad dag /'phags ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par mos la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes bzla/ bzlas dmigs de dag gis thun gyi dngos gzhi 'khyol bar bya/ de'ang phyis kyi gsung rgyun tu rnal 'byor ma la bsnyen pa oṃ gsum ma bzla ba (353)dang*/ bzlas pa'i gtso bo'ang de la bya zhing gzhan rnams cung zad re bzla bar bzhed pa dang*/ kha cig tu mgon po'i bsnyen pa nyi dbungs bskyed par gsungs pa sogs de dang de dag gi rnal 'byor gtsor bton pa la dgongs par mngon zhing*/ 'dir spyi tsam du/ bla ma'i gsol 'debs kyi bzlas pa cung zad mang ba dang gzhan rnams cha snyoms par bzla'o// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang len pa ni/ sngags tshan lnga po sprel te gsol 'debs kyi tshul du lan gsum bzlas la mos gus drag tu bskyed pas// bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros/

'khor du bzhugs pa'i lha bzhi spyan drangs te/ bla ma'i spyi bor spyan ras gzigs/ mgrin par rje btsun sgrol ma/ thugs kar ye shes mgon po// lte bar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams bzhugs par mos/ slar yang bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ye shes chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs thams cad lha bzhi'i rnam par spyan drangs te bla ma'i sku'i nang thams cad bong ba 'brus khengs pa ltar so so'i cha la gtams par bsam/ de nas rang gi lus kyi stong ra'i dbus su rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal ba'i dbu ma'i mar snar a shad skyer tshor lta bu/ gsang ba bshang sgo dang nye bar rlung gi dkyil 'khor bcas gsal btab la/ rlung kha sbyor ram/ mi nus na 'og rlung cung zad bskums pa'i ye shes kyi rlung sbyor byas pas/ rang gi gsang gnas nas rlung g.yos/ lte ba'i a shad la phog pas gtum mo ye shes kyi me dmar lhag gis 'bar/ rang gi spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas thon/ chos 'byung la phog pas cher dros/ des lha rnams dros/ (354)de yi rkyen gyis bde chen bzod med du 'bar te lus lha rnams bdud rtsir ltem gyis zhu/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byon te rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ snying ga yan chad gang*/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ lte ba yan chad gang*/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ rdo rje gsum gyi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs par mos/ mthar chos 'byung nam mkhar rang yal/ bla ma dgyes pa chen pos 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/

rang yang stong nyid du thim/ bla ma rang sems dbyer med du 'dres par mos/ gsum pa rjes la gnyis/ gnas lugs bskyang ba dang*/ thun mtshams la 'jug pa'o// dang po ni/ bla ma rang la thim pa'i rjes thog de ma thag par lus gnad chos bdun bca'/ ngag gnad rlung ro dgu phrugs su bsal la rgyu ba gnyis po rang babs su bzhag /sems gnad dus gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa gang gi'ang rjes su mi 'brang*/ bzang ngan blang dor re dogs gang yang yid la mi byed par shes pa had de chad de'i rang ngo rang shes kyi dran pas dgag sgrub bzo bcos med par bskyangs la/ dang po grim gyis bsgrim/ bar du lhod kyis klod/ mthar gnyug ma'i rang ngo shes bzhin gyi dran pa'i mdangs ma shor ba la bslab cing ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa de las ldangs te thun mtshams kyi spyod lam la 'jug pa ni/ ci snang bla ma yi dam sgyu ma chos nyid kyi shes pa dang ma bral ba'i dang*// sems can thams cad bde (355)gyur cig /sems can thams cad nad med par// sangs rgyas nyid du 'gro ba yi// lam de nyid du 'grub gyur cig /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la// da lta nyid du gnas par shog /ces smon lam btab// legs pa'i yon tan rab rdzogs pa// bla ma yi dam bkra shis shog /phrin las thams cad sgrub mdzad pa// mkha' 'gro chos skyong bkra shis shog /ces bkra shis brjod// dge ba'i tshogs rnams bsags pa kun// bdag gis yongs su bzung med par// sems can ma lus kun don tu// chos dbyings bla na med par bsngo// zhes sogs kyis dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngos nas chos ldan gyi spyod lam la 'jug go*/ 'dir bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnal 'byor gyis mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di la ster bar byed cing*/ de sgrub pa'i skabs su gegs sel ba dang bogs 'don pa gnyis la lam gyi rim pa rags las pas/

phyi'i gegs sel mgon po// nang gi gegs sel sgrol ma/ phyi byams snying rje'i bogs 'don spyan ras gzigs/ nang bde drod kyi bogs 'don rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams mthar thug yin par yongs su grags shing grub pas nyams len thun gcig la rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim yongs su rdzogs pa'i zag gnad khyad par 'phags pa yin par ma zad/ ji skad du/ ma yengs zla ba gsum na 'grub// tho rangs thun re ma chags bsgom// mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub 'grub// ces gsungs te grub pa gnyis lo zla tsam gyis ster bar byed pa yin pas na dam pa'i chos la skal pa mi dman pa'i bsod nams dang blo gros can ngag gis nyams len gyi snying po (356)g.yar dam du bya'o// grub brnyes gser gyi phreng bar mchog sbyin pa'i// lha bzhi'i khrid yig grub pa'i zhal lung bzhin// 'dus gsal spel 'dir skal bzang kun zhugs nas// mchog grub thang mas 'jig rten brdal byed shog /ces pa'ang rigs brgya'i khyab bdag bka' drin mnyam med kun gzigs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas zab khrid byin rlabs bcas bka' drin tu stsal ba'i tshe gsung gis rjes su gnang ba dang*/ yang khrod kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling gi sgrub la gzhol ba rnams kyi nyams len nye bar mkho bas mtshams sbyar te bla ma'i zhal lung rang bzo'i rnyogs pas ma bslad par/ mang thos kyi spong ba pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos de bī ko ṭi'i dben khrod du bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// /
